.. change::
    :tags: bug, postgresql
    :tickets: 13762

    Fixed PostgreSQL reflection of ``tsquery`` and ``regconfig`` columns, which
    returned ``NullType`` and emitted a warning even though the dialect exposes
    ``TSQUERY`` and ``REGCONFIG`` types. The types are now included in
    ``ischema_names`` so reflection uses them consistently with ``tsvector``.
    Pull request courtesy Lushiyao5.
